pr.body:
## Summary

Record the live, two-phase replacement of the sole founder's primitive Google Cloud Owner grant with explicit predefined project-administrator roles. This remains a one-human control model; it does not claim segregation of duties.

## Tickets

Closes #62.

## Changes

- records the verified removal of `roles/owner`
- records the explicit Firebase, Cloud Run, artifact, IAM, service, monitoring, and logging administrator roles retained by the founder
- adds the read-only Shadow verifier service account to the quarterly population review
- updates the access register and role matrix without inventing a second person

## Test Plan

- inspect the live Google Cloud IAM policy for `dor@dorkalev.com`: explicit role set present, Owner absent
- run Shadow verifier tests: 26 passed
- run dashboard tests: 8 passed
- run `git diff --check`
